name: alertosaurus
description: Desktop notification hub with a pixel-art dinosaur

scripts.build:copy: shx mkdir -p dist/pet dist/hub && shx cp src/pet/index.html src/pet/pet.css dist/pet/ && shx cp src/hub/index.html src/hub/hub.css dist/hub/
scripts.build:cli: shx mkdir -p dist/cli && cd cli && go build -ldflags="-s -w" -trimpath -o ../dist/cli/roar .
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:copy && npm run build:cli

author: Jonas Curth <curth@mediainterface.de>
